intents_zh: 每日備份保留 N 份
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SRC="{{src_dir}}"
ROOT="{{dst_root}}"
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
LATEST="$ROOT/latest"
TARGET="$ROOT/$DATE"

mkdir -p "$ROOT"

rsync -aAX --delete \
  --link-dest="$LATEST" \
  --exclude='.cache' --exclude='node_modules' \
  "$SRC/" "$TARGET/"

rm -f "$LATEST"
ln -s "$DATE" "$LATEST"

find "$ROOT" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '20*' -mtime +{{keep_days}} -exec rm -rf {} +
summary_zh: rsync 硬連結增量備份保留 N 天
